name: Ryazhenka
description: Milk baked for hours until caramel-coloured, then cultured — nuttier than kefir.

ayurveda.note: Baking and souring are both ushna.

unani.note: Outside the classical record; garam-tar by the baking and ferment.

histamine.note: Cultured dairy; the long bake concentrates it before the ferment even starts.

effects.note: Ryazhenka is fermented with the same Lactobacillus bulgaricus and Streptococcus thermophilus cultures credited with yogurt's own lactose-digestion effect, just cultured into baked rather than plain milk — untested directly, but the same live cultures doing the same job. A possible effect, not a promise — response to it varies from person to person.
